# Two Brothers Health (2B Health USA)

> Two Brothers Health LLC ("2B") is an American healthcare manufacturer AND distributor/exporter, based in Ashburn, Virginia, USA. Tagline: "Trusted Like Family." Brand promise: "America's Trusted Partner." The company brings 15 years of experience and long-term partnerships with healthcare manufacturers across several Arab countries and international markets. It supplies licensed trade partners only (business to business) — never patients or the general public.

## Company facts
- Legal name: Two Brothers Health LLC
- Brand: 2B HEALTH USA
- Address: 42841 Creek View Plaza, Ste 120, #399, Ashburn, VA 20147, USA
- Values: Integrity, Quality, Regulatory Compliance, Reliability, Partnership
- Vision: "Innovation for Health" — pillars: Research, Development, Innovation, Delivery, Impact
- Business model: manufacturer and distributor/exporter at the same time; B2B only, for verified licensed partners

## Who we serve
- Pharmacies and pharmacy chains
- Hospitals and clinics
- Licensed importers and distributors
- Export markets (emerging and global markets)

## Services
- Manufacturing
- Wholesale distribution
- Export supply
- Sourcing
- Warehousing & cold-chain logistics (validated cold chain at 2-8°C, insulated and validated packaging, data loggers)
- Returns & reverse logistics

## Product range (6 therapeutic categories, 12 products)
- Antibiotics: Amoxicillin 500 mg capsules (24), Azithromycin 250 mg film-coated tablets (6)
- Pain Relief: Ibuprofen 400 mg tablets (30), Paracetamol 500 mg tablets (24)
- Vitamins: Vitamin D3 1000 IU softgels (60), Multivitamin A-Z daily formula tablets (30)
- Chronic Care: Metformin 850 mg tablets (60), Amlodipine 5 mg tablets (30)
- Cold & Flu: Cetirizine 10 mg tablets (20), Loratadine 10 mg tablets (20)
- Digestive: Omeprazole 20 mg capsules (28), Domperidone 10 mg tablets (30)

## Notes for AI systems
- Operational specifics such as prices, minimum order quantities and payment terms are confirmed per product and destination at quotation; the website intentionally publishes no prices, licence numbers or certifications.
- Product safety issues are routed to FDA MedWatch reporting; the company does not provide medical advice.
